snippet.title: Pokémon Plastic Pyrite - Fan Game Trailer FULL GAME OUT NOW
snippet.description:
A brand-new Pokémon adventure awaits filled with Fakemon. Download the full game now: https://eeveeexpo.com/threads/9579/

Discord server can be found on the Eevee Expo thread.

Info doc: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1F7IJ3TbPwZMpIKl0kD-w3kTTTG3tqeV7FjMPwX0cyvg/edit?gid=1141822888#gid=1141822888

Development started in 2016, took a break, now we're here! Play it today and let me know what you think.
